description: This is the main App component for a React-based frontend application. It manages theme toggling between light and dark modes and sets up routing for '/' and '/signin' pages. It imports external components (React, react-router-dom, SignIn) and uses React hooks for state and effect management.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main functional component that manages theme state, routing, and renders the Home page and SignIn page.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle theme state between light and dark.
